evidence.title: MLB proposes shorter regular season, longer Division Series

occurrences.checkable_against: MLB collective bargaining proposal on player compensation
occurrences.quote_span: MLB said player salaries would not be adjusted to reflect fewer games and bonus provision thresholds — like those that pay players for games played — would be adjusted to reflect the shortened schedule.
occurrences.speaker: Major League Baseball
occurrences.subject: Major League Baseball

occurrences.checkable_against: MLB Players Association bargaining records and public statements
occurrences.quote_span: The players’ association said it will review the plan and will respond at the bargaining table.
occurrences.speaker: Major League Baseball Players Association
occurrences.subject: Major League Baseball

occurrences.checkable_against: MLB collective bargaining proposal and regular-season schedule
occurrences.quote_span: Returning to a 154-game schedule would allow us to introduce a weekly off day
occurrences.speaker: MLB spokesman Glen Caplin
occurrences.subject: Major League Baseball

occurrences.checkable_against: MLB official regular-season schedule and collective bargaining proposal
occurrences.quote_span: MLB’s regular season currently schedules 162 games over 187 days, and the new format would play the 154 games over 180 in most years.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Major League Baseball

occurrences.checkable_against: MLB collective bargaining proposal for Division Series calendar
occurrences.quote_span: Each best-of-seven series would be played over 11 days instead of nine, adding off days before Games 5 and 7 in addition to the travel days before Games 3 and 6.
occurrences.speaker: Major League Baseball
occurrences.subject: Major League Baseball

occurrences.checkable_against: MLB labor bargaining proposal and MLB Players Association statements
occurrences.quote_span: MLB proposed a salary cap, which the union has vowed to never accept, along with limits on contract values and length.
occurrences.speaker: Major League Baseball
occurrences.subject: Major League Baseball

occurrences.checkable_against: MLB collective bargaining proposal on player compensation
occurrences.quote_span: MLB said player salaries would not be adjusted to reflect fewer games
occurrences.speaker: Major League Baseball
occurrences.subject: Major League Baseball

occurrences.checkable_against: MLB collective bargaining proposal for Division Series opponent selection
occurrences.quote_span: the No. 1 seeds could pick which wild-card winner to play in the Division Series.
occurrences.speaker: Major League Baseball

occurrences.checkable_against: MLB collective bargaining proposal for postseason schedule
occurrences.quote_span: There would be only two games scheduled on each of the first three days rather than the current format of up to four games per day.

occurrences.subject: Major League Baseball

occurrences.checkable_against: MLB collective bargaining proposal for the 2029 regular-season schedule
occurrences.quote_span: Major League Baseball proposed to shorten the regular season to 154 games from 162 starting in 2029
occurrences.speaker: Major League Baseball
occurrences.subject: Major League Baseball

occurrences.checkable_against: MLB Players Association public statements on salary-cap proposals
occurrences.quote_span: which the union has vowed to never accept

occurrences.subject: Major League Baseball

occurrences.checkable_against: MLB collective bargaining proposal for regular-season scheduling

occurrences.checkable_against: MLB collective bargaining proposal for postseason calendar
occurrences.quote_span: Owners also proposed adding nine additional days off to the current postseason format, extending it to a maximum 42 days

occurrences.subject: Major League Baseball

occurrences.checkable_against: MLB collective bargaining proposal for postseason game times
occurrences.quote_span: MLB would stop scheduling early round postseason games in afternoons

occurrences.subject: Major League Baseball

occurrences.quote_span: expand the Division Series to best-of-seven

occurrences.checkable_against: MLB collective bargaining proposal for postseason calendar
occurrences.quote_span: extending it to a maximum 42 days

occurrences.checkable_against: MLB collective bargaining proposal for Wild Card Series opponent selection
occurrences.quote_span: No. 3 seeds could select after the regular season whether to host No. 5 or No. 6 in the Wild Card Series

occurrences.subject: Major League Baseball

occurrences.checkable_against: MLB collective bargaining proposal for Wild Card Series format
occurrences.quote_span: MLB would keep the Wild Card Series at best-of-three at the ballpark of the higher-seeded team, add an extra day off between Games 1 and 2 and stagger series starts.
occurrences.speaker: Major League Baseball

occurrences.checkable_against: MLB collective bargaining proposal for regular-season calendar

occurrences.checkable_against: MLB collective bargaining proposal for team scheduling

occurrences.subject: Major League Baseball
